name: io.github.prodxpdev/titlesearch
title: Titlesearch
description: Checks if a product name is free across domain extensions, and who holds the taken ones.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Lets the server judge market overlap and suggest names itself; otherwise Claude does.

environmentVariables.name: PORKBUN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. With PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY, adds prices from Porkbun. A sandbox key (pk1_sb_) is recommended.

environmentVariables.name: NAMECOM_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional. With NAMECOM_TOKEN, adds prices from Name.com.
